# M6.3 inventory reconciliation

Every one of the 85,614 items of the M0 source-backed inventory has one preparation treatment and one owner. The per-item ledger is [reconciliation.json.gz](reconciliation.json.gz): each group names its family, phase, M0 stage, owner, treatment and item IDs (call, syntax, capture, origin and traversal IDs; `origin:traversal` for contributions; `K` and `X` numbers are row positions in the pinned consumer and excluded-edge ledgers; model declarations by name). Its inputs are pinned by SHA-256.
